item.title: Bruce Springsteen biographer and music critic Dave Marsh dies at 76
item.summary: This image provided by The Kristen Ann Carr Fund shows Dave Marsh speaking at the KACF "A Night to Remember" event at the Tribeca Grill in New York, April 20, 2013. (Marc Levine/The Kristen Ann Carr Fund via AP) 2026-08-17T13:51:41Z Dave Marsh, a longtime music critic who wrote several influential books about Bruce Springsteen , including the early biography “Born to Run” has died. He was 76. Marsh died Friday in Connecticut, his friend Jeffrey St. Clair, a co-editor of the online magazine Counterpunch, told The Associated Press. St. Clair said Marsh had been suffering from a degenerative brain disease for several years. Jim Rotolo, the SiriusXM radio host, announced Marsh’s death on his social media accounts. Springsteen paid tribute to Marsh in an Instagram post, writing that the loss had left the band “heartbroken.” “My great friend Dave, with his straight out of Detroit attitude, was a true Rock ‘n’ Roll lifer.
